items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: And Pee Wee Russell was playing at the arcade, if Pee Wee ever come here, he'll tell you that.

ctx.x: You take my mother. My mother was a full-blooded Indian. Uh-huh. Because my mother is very polite. She's the same tribe as Pee-Wee Russell.
